title: Usage event steward: schema resolution, lineage tagging, and tenant-aware backpressure
creator: Rohit Kapoor
description: Implement a lightweight, stateful 'Usage Event Steward' service in the console backend that performs runtime schema resolution, attaches event provenance/lineage tags, and applies tenant-aware backpressure/queueing. This ticket covers the service spec, integration with the existing ingest gateway, metrics/tracing hooks, and a canary rollout plan. The goal is to reduce downstream schema-failure noise, make deprecations graceful, and enable safe evolution of ingestion contracts without dropping user traffic unnecessarily.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming events are validated against a resolution policy (per-tenant) and either accepted, enriched, or marked for soft quarantine based on rules
Lineage/provenance fields (producer_id, source_version, resolution_path) are attached to every event accepted into the main pipeline
Tenant-aware backpressure enforces per-tenant in-flight limits and triggers graceful degradation to permissive validation instead of hard rejection when capacity is constrained
Canary rollout (start at 5%, rise to 25%) completed with no >1% increase in observed end-to-end latency or error-rate for canary cohort
Operational dashboards show schema mismatch rate, per-tenant queue depth, quarantine counts, and time-to-resolution for enriched events
Rollback path documented and automated feature-flag toggle exists to disable the steward and route to previous ingest behavior
tasks: Finalize schema resolution algorithm and policy model (strict/permissive/repair/enrich)
Design event-provenance header and storage schema for lineage tags
Implement steward service with small in-memory sharded state for tenant throttles
Integrate steward as a pre-ingest stage in the ingest gateway (gRPC hook)
Add metrics and tracing spans (OpenTelemetry) and wire to console dashboards
Create e2e test harness with synthetic schema drift scenarios
Author operational runbook and rollback playbook
Prepare canary rollout plan and coordinate with SRE for capacity windows
